test_mcp_loop_exception_handler: test the _mcp_loop_exception_handler to suppress benign 'Event loop is closed' errors while forwarding other exceptions
test_ensure_mcp_loop: test _ensure_mcp_loop installs the exception handler on the new event loop and _stop_mcp_loop cleans it up
test_snapshot_child_pids: test _snapshot_child_pids returns a set of integer PIDs from child processes
test_kill_orphaned_mcp_children: test _kill_orphaned_mcp_children gracefully kills orphaned subprocesses using SIGKILL or SIGTERM fallback
test_mcpservertask_retry: test MCPServerTask retries initial connection failures with backoff and respects shutdown events
